best_lineage.idea: Replace raw inputs with a comprehensive 2nd-order polynomial feature set (raw inputs + log(x3) + all 15 pairwise products + all 6 squares) so the linear classifier can represent any quadratic nonlinear boundary in the original space, which is the most common form of hidden rule in synthetic data.

Replace the unbounded polynomial basis with a bounded multi-scale tanh activation set plus hard threshold indicators and sign/quadrant features, which directly captures step-function and XOR-like boundaries that polynomials can only approximate with many terms, and the multi-scale tanh lets a single linear weight fit different sharpnesses of the same threshold.
